meta.title: Amin Tailor | Premium Bespoke Tailoring - Custom Suits & Alterations
meta.description: Expert bespoke tailoring crafted to perfection. Custom suits, alterations, and personal consultations. Experience premium craftsmanship with hundreds of satisfied clients.

hero.title: Craftedto PerfectIon
hero.subtitle: Bespoke tailoring crafted specifically for your style and personality.

philosophy.label: OUR PHILOSOPHY
philosophy.heading: Every Stitch,A Masterpiece
philosophy.body: At Amin Tailor, we believe the perfect garment is more than clothing — it's self-expression. With years of experience, we blend traditional techniques and modern touches to create something truly yours.

bespoke.title: Bespoke Tailoring
bespoke.tagline: Garments custom-made for your body and style
bespoke.description: Our bespoke process begins with detailed body measurements, premium fabric selection, and final fitting. Every pattern is designed uniquely — no two bespoke suits are alike. Minimum 3 fitting sessions for perfect results.

alteration.title: Alterations
alteration.tagline: Perfect the garments you already own
alteration.description: From simple adjustments to total restyling, we transform your garments for a perfect fit. Hemming, taking in, letting out, shoulder adjustments, and more — all done to the highest standards.

consultation.title: Personal Consultation
consultation.tagline: Discover your best style with our experts
consultation.description: Personal consultations to help you discover the style, silhouette, and color palette that suits you best. We guide you in choosing fabrics, designs, and details that reflect your personality.

about.label: ABOUT US
about.heading: The Story BehindEvery Stitch
about.body1: Amin Tailor was born from a deep passion for the art of tailoring. Under Amin's leadership, we have served hundreds of clients seeking more than just clothing — they seek an experience.
about.body2: Every piece that leaves our workshop is a blend of traditional techniques and modern innovation. We believe the best garments don't just fit the body — they tell the story of the wearer.
